snippets.output: Corneal abrasions commonly cause reflex tearing and a watery discharge from the eye.

snippets.output: Corneal abrasions do not always cause eye discharge; any discharge may be watery, minimal, or absent, especially in the early stages.
snippets.pattern_notes: Enumerates discharge characteristics (variable, minimal, absent, early-stage) of corneal abrasions.
